approach: Native x86-64 execution through a ported runtime and PS4 ABI implementations; shadPS4 GPU command/shader translation to Vulkan. No static CPU recompilation.
help: Steam Deck and AMD GPU testing
notes: Experimental public prerelease. Windows smoke tests cover the title island, pool camera, hotel/save transitions and several activities. Native Linux builds and a graphical Steam Deck installer are available; actual Steam Deck gameplay is unverified. Full-game, outfit and shader coverage remains incomplete. Runtime ancestry includes Uncharted: The Nathan Drake Collection and The Order: 1886; full credits are linked. Users supply their own matching game and system-module files.
